protocol.eligibility: at least 20 catalogue movie ratings at 4 stars or higher
protocol.candidate_pool: all linked catalogue movies except seeds
protocol.cf_split: 80 percent train users, 20 percent test users; validation is first 20 percent of test users
protocol.bootstrap: paired query bootstrap, 10000 resamples, 95 percent CI
protocol.popularity_filter: held-out items not all in train global top-100

h6.verdict: H6 supported: at least one adapter has a positive, CI-separated Recall@10 gain over its zero-shot model.

notes: ALS was skipped because the optional implicit package is not installed.
Item-kNN uses the 80 percent train-user rating matrix; popularity is train rating count.
The hybrid weight is selected from the first 20 percent of held-out test users and then fixed for evaluation users.
